de.abas.ceks.jedp

Class EDPRowAddress

  • Object
    • EDPRowRange
      • EDPRowAddress
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class EDPRowAddress
extends EDPRowRange
implements Serializable
    Objects of this class carry a row address to access editor fields or rows within an editor. A row address addresses exactly one row in the table part of a data object.
    Version:
    1
    Author:
    xg

      • EDPRowAddress

      • EDPRowAddress

        public EDPRowAddress(String rowSpec)
        Creates a row address for a row using a String as row specification. The row specification must address exactly one row. This can be one of the following:
        • a row number, "" and "0" are also allowed and address the header
        • a row id, e.g. "(12345,2,0,5)"
        • symbolic row address "#" (last row) or "." (current row)
        • a $ selection on the table part which returns exactly one row
        Parameters:
        rowSpec - a row specification string addressing exactly one row

    • Method Detail

      • getRowNumber

        public int getRowNumber()
        Provides the row number of this row address, but only if it was created using a number. If the row address was created using a rowSpec string, no row number is available.
        Returns:
        the row number of this row address, if available; -1 else.

      • getEditRowID

        public String getEditRowID()
        Provides the editor row of this row adress, but only if it was created unsing a row number or an editor row. If the row address was created using a rowSpec string, no editor row is available.
        Returns:
        the row number of this row address, if available; null else.
